lines.text: Whew! I’m trying to memorize all my notes.

OK, everyone!\c
Where can you find information that is useful
for Trainers?\c
That’s right! In this classroom, you can find it
on the blackboard or in books!\c
Please read bulletin boards for Trainer Tips
in towns and cities, too!
If you walk around with your Pokémon or let\nthem battle, they’ll grow to love you even more!
We’re studying about the Pokémon types.
Let’s see, Pikachu is Electric type...\c\nThat means it has an advantage against Water-\nand Flying-type Pokémon!
Eevee is a Normal type.\c\nIt doesn’t have too many weaknesses, but it is\nweak against Fighting-type moves!

Let’s check out the notebook.\c
The first page says...\c
“Poké Balls are used to catch and
carry Pokémon.\c
“People who raise and battle with
Pokémon are called Trainers.”

The second page says...\c
“To try to catch a Pokémon, throw a Poké Ball at
the center of the white ring!\c
“If you throw a Poké Ball while a Pokémon is
moving, you may not be able to catch it.”

The third page says...\c
“Pokémon Trainers seek others to battle and
defeat in Pokémon battles.\c
“To Trainers, the taste of victory
is sweet indeed.\c
“Battles are constantly waged at Pokémon
Gyms everywhere.”

The fourth page says...\c
“The goal for all Pokémon Trainers is simple. It is
to defeat the eight Gym Leaders in the region.\c
“Do so to earn the right to face...the extremely
strong Elite Four of the Pokémon League!”
Do you want to turn the page?
GIRL: Hey!\nDon’t look at my notes!
The blackboard lists status conditions that can\nhappen to Pokémon during battles.
Which topic do you want to read?
Falling asleep
Getting burned
Being poisoned
Being frozen
Paralysis
Never mind

“If a Pokémon falls asleep, it will be unable to
attack till it wakes.\c
“It will stay asleep after battle.\c
“Use an Awakening to wake it up.”

“When a Pokémon is burned, its Attack is
lowered and it will steadily lose HP.\c
“This lingers even after battle.
Use a Burn Heal to cure it.”
“If a Pokémon is poisoned, it’ll steadily lose HP.\c\n“Poisoning won’t disappear after the battle,\nso heal it with an Antidote.”

“If a Pokémon is frozen, it becomes
helplessly immobile.\c
“It stays frozen even after the battle ends.
Use an Ice Heal to thaw it out.”

“Paralysis reduces Speed and may prevent a
Pokémon from using moves in battle.\c
“And paralysis doesn’t go away after the battle
ends, either. Use a Paralyze Heal to treat it.”
There are some notes in the notebook!\c\n“The Pokémon with the higher [VAR COLOR(0006)]Speed[VAR COLOR(0000)] stat gets\nto move first!”

There are some notes in the notebook!\c
“[VAR COLOR(0006)]Attack[VAR COLOR(0000)] affects physical moves. [VAR COLOR(0006)]Sp. Atk[VAR COLOR(0000)] affects
special moves. The higher the stat, the more
damage the move does!”

“In addition to HP, Pokémon have PP, which they
use to perform moves.\c
“Recover PP by resting your tired Pokémon at
a Pokémon Center.”
